answers.rationale: This requirement specifies construction materials for walls, which is not directly tied to a specific product in the catalog. It is likely part of the bid manager's scope.

The requirement describes structural and installation details for switchgear assemblies. CROWN-ARMV is suitable as it provides arc-resistant metal-clad MV switchgear, which aligns with the described structural framework and installation requirements.
This requirement specifies insulation values and preferences for the structure, which is not directly tied to a specific product in the catalog. It is likely part of the bid manager's scope.

The requirement specifies compartmentalization and isolation for switchgear components. CROWN-ARMV provides arc-resistant metal-clad MV switchgear with compartmentalized construction, meeting these specifications.
The requirement describes operational and safety features for circuit breaker compartments. CROWN-ARMV includes vacuum breakers and interlocks, which align with the described features.

The requirement specifies cable entry plates and supports for feeder cables. CROWN-ACC provides accessories for MV switchgear, including cable termination compartments and related hardware, which meet these specifications.
